evidence.excerpt: Grbić has expressed a preference for collaborations that can access production-scale extrusion equipment, as the laboratory cast-film line is limited to 45 mm screw diameter and cannot replicate all industrial conditions. He is not currently on sabbatical and is available for new project discussions.
